title: MorseCraft
description: A simple client-side mod that enables the easy use of printed morse code via in-game chat
body:
# MorseCraft

MorseCraft is a simple client-side mod that makes it easier to use printed morse in in-game chat.

## Functionality

In game, type your morse code surrounded by backticks (`) to denote your morse code as MorseCraft-compatible. When someone using MorseCraft receives a message in their chat window, the message is processed by MorseCraft. This removes backticks around the morse and highlights it aqua. When you hover over it, the translation will appear.

There are two available commands:
- /toMorse <plaintext> : Convert plaintext to Morse (for those who can't yet do morse in their head)
- /fromMorse <morse> : Convert morse code into plaintext. This is helpful for morse in books or other media.

*Note: MorseCraft currently will remove formatting given by servers if morse is detected in messages. This includes styling and color formatting. This will be patched in release (v1.0.0)*
